Method of Attack: Ransomware-as-a-service (RaaS) with affiliates compromising corporate networks to deploy ransomware; Double-extortion tactic stealing unencrypted files and threatening release if ransom not paid; Use of VOIP calls to journalists and victim's business partners to pressure ransom payments; Use of DDoS attacks including Layer 3 (Internet connection) and Layer 7 (web server) attacks to pressure victims; Voice-scrambled VOIP calls to media and victim's business partners; Paid service for affiliates to perform Layer 3 and Layer 7 DDoS attacks
Impacted Systems: Publicly accessible applications such as web servers
Attack Vector: Compromise of corporate networks by affiliates
VOIP calls to media and business partners
